name: Aerospace
description: Aerospace assembly and MRO operations demand high-performance adhesives, sealants, and contamination-control supplies. InOut's product range supports bonding, corrosion protection, and cleanroom handling for avionics and structural components.

name: Pharmaceutical
description: GMP-compliant pharmaceutical facilities trust InOut for sterile cleanroom garments, powder-free gloves, face masks, and controlled-environment consumables that support aseptic manufacturing and regulatory compliance.

name: Hospitality
description: Hotels, restaurants, and food service operations rely on InOut for hygienic cleaning supplies, PPE, and contamination-control products that meet food safety standards and maintain a clean, safe environment for staff and guests.

name: Medical Device
description: Medical device manufacturers require validated, traceable consumables. InOut provides ISO-certified cleanroom wipes, gloves, and packaging materials that meet ISO 13485 and FDA requirements for device production and assembly.

name: Semiconductor & Microelectronics
description: Semiconductor fabs demand ultra-clean environments and zero-defect consumables. InOut supplies ISO Class 4–6 cleanroom gloves, wipes, face masks, and ESD-safe apparel engineered to meet the stringent particle and contamination standards of wafer fabrication and chip packaging lines.
